title: The Bleeding Altar
text: At the hour of matins, the altar in your chapel bleeds. The blood is warm, and it runs uphill toward the window that faces the Rift Gate.

options.label: Have the altar consecrated again, paying whatever the priest asks.

outcomes.text: The bleeding stops. The priest who did it leaves the city that night without saying why.
The bleeding stops. Then the font starts.

options.label: Collect the blood in a bowl; something that runs uphill is worth keeping.

outcomes.text: The blood dries to a fine red ash, which the Apothecary pays well for.
The Scion who held the bowl has bled from the eyes at matins ever since.

options.label: Kneel and pray with it to learn what prays through the altar.

outcomes.text: Whatever is praying through the altar is glad of company. The House's most devout is changed by it.
